Page 187 Feb. 9 Mrs. May Rigley - 53 -threatened with loss of eye. - double vision ... 12 Helane Wiedling - 22 - "good girl till some months ago started asso- ciation with a divorced person ....
M. Mary Smith - 1 yr - three months old before found to be blind .... Mrs. Anna Stakoe - 45 - ailing since husband died two years ago - had stroke yesterday ....
14 Page 188
Feb. 14 Gordon Duchene - 48 - janator in St. Rose School - hemoraging since yesterday A.M.
Mrs. Genv. Etherly - 56 - now in Grace Hosp. under ovservation - kid- ney & bladder trouble ....
Delia Duffy - 677 E. Gr. Blv'd - 43 - keeping roomers and trying make honest living - out of coat etc.
Ervin Hasenberg - 43 - appendicitis operation - unconscious from 2nd till 7th of Febr. Febr. was enrolled over the phone - next day his sister and her husband went to see him in Ann Arbor Hospital and he introduced them to another Dr. their present. . . . Thanks ....
George Moutie now 24- at 18 had become quite indifferent to religion .... T.B .... hopeless - lost 7 ribs. home now and really practical in attention to his soul ....
Wm. Mahon - 62 - in accident 3 weeks ago receiving broken ankle ... in- fection feared ....
Mrs. Geo Diegel - 65 - in Ostipath Hospit. - heart trouble ....
Peter O'Grady - 17 - brain hemorages - two operations on scull - can see only some inches ....
Page 189 Feb. 18 18 Richard Oliveri - 4 - unable to sit or stand alone or talk - when 2 was starting to talk - then was frightened some way .... parents receive once or twice a year .... Enrolled To-day ...
Thanks. .. Mrs. Dorothy DeCaussin - 43 - Thank for prayers .... not well. Drs. feared serious operation for tuomer ... was prayed for and on St. Blase Day the family was with happy birth of 3rd boy.
